title: fix(state): a supersede target must still be open — two racing writers can no longer leave two current records
context:
Two Sofias serving one clinic each held the same summary as the incumbent
and both superseded it; the contract closed the incumbent twice and left
both successors current (fnd_eeb8bf3cb8). A `supersedes` that names an
already-closed commitment or derived record is now a `conflict` naming
the record that is current for that subject, so the loser re-reads and
supersedes that one. The writer that closed the incumbent itself (same
derived id under a new key) is exempt and is an in-place update with  Touches invariant(s): con_902759b3dc (All JSON writes to .hunch/ must be atomic (temp-file + rename) so an interrupted write can never truncate the index); con_a87360128b (Semantic vectors are a derived layer in SQLite, never the source of truth; reconcile by content hash on reindex).
decision: Changed code in src/store, test/state-binding.test.ts (2 file(s)).
